# Roman Mednitzer

> Senior Systems & Platform Engineer · Vienna, Austria

Canonical profile: https://rmednitzer.github.io/
Last reviewed: 2026-10-26.

## Profile

I’m Roman, a systems and platform engineer based in Vienna. I work across infrastructure layers, connecting requirements and hands-on integration with reliable operation, troubleshooting and recovery.

I have around ten years of production infrastructure experience across managed services, enterprise infrastructure and a regulated medical-device environment. My work spans Linux, virtualisation, storage, networking and container platforms.

## Personal projects

These are personal, AI-assisted projects outside employment. I use AI substantially for implementation, testing and documentation; I own requirements, integration decisions, review and operational validation.

- [relay-shell](https://github.com/rmednitzer/relay-shell): A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for shell commands, SSH and interactive sessions, with operation records and configurable policy. It is open by default, runs with the service account’s authority and is not a sandbox.
- [osint-workbench](https://github.com/rmednitzer/osint-workbench): A self-hostable workbench for collecting public information, preserving evidence and searching it, with optional enrichment and read-only assistant access. Work in progress, with bounded workflows and a disposable integration-test environment. Full operational qualification remains open.

## Interests

My wider technical interests include robotics and autonomy, cybernetics and human augmentation, defence and mission systems, and edge and high-performance computing. These are areas I explore and follow.

Outside engineering, I read hard science fiction and listen to industrial and electronic body music (EBM).
